question: Can labelled field learner families close the actual delivery gap to the strong fixed logistic recipe while protecting rare classes?
hypothesis: Changing augmentation, calibrated probabilities and SVC did not beat the strong fixed recipe. Test previously missing field-trained squared-loss, randomized-tree and boosted-tree families, rather than route the closed augmented bank again.

Verify archived linear snapshots and service IDs, parent industrial weights and same selected feedback; fit only prior returned labels. Save and reload each pipeline, hand off actual service output before revealing new feedback. Report rescued/harmed rows relative to fixed-midway.
selection: Pilot seeds17,47,89. A family/scale arm proceeds to all13 existing development draws only if pilot mean Macro-F1 is at least fixed-midway minus0.005 and both pilot-mean and seed17 worst recall are within0.02 of observer; default-seed Macro-F1 must exceed observer. Confirmation uses the original strict gate: mean Macro-F1 exceeds strongest matched fixed control, default seed improves current, and mean/default worst recall within0.02 of current. Development draws do not count as independent data. Only a confirmed winner receives complete public-run all and frozen independent validation before adoption. If none screens in, close these fixed family configurations without tuning service answers.
